title: Install or recover Annals
summary: Install, update, validate, or recover the user-owned Annals and Annals Usage deployment, including an explicitly authorized fresh-state cutover.
use_when: The user-owned macOS Annals and Annals Usage binaries, configuration, content-addressed release, LaunchAgent, library, or spool must be installed, updated, or recovered.
An explicitly authorized fresh-state replacement must preserve uncompleted backlog and rollback as one generation.
do_not_use_when: The task is ordinary use or administration of an already installed library or inbox.
Source development or Git release publication is the intended outcome.
A destructive fresh-state cutover has not been explicitly authorized.
outcome: A validated complete installed Annals and Annals Usage release with matching configuration, scheduler, library/spool generation, Nucleus boundary, and rollback state.
effects: Stages and atomically selects a complete content-addressed release containing Annals, Annals Usage, runners, configuration, and provider documentation.
May quiesce the LaunchAgent, establish maintenance, migrate the library, replace launchd configuration, and restart scheduled inbox processing.
With `--fresh-state`, replaces the library and spool together, imports uncompleted backlog in lane order, and retains the prior generation for rollback.
A failed pre-commit cutover restores captured program, service, configuration, library, and spool state according to the supported procedure.
authority: Annals owns its installed programs, library, spool, scheduler, configuration, migration, maintenance, and recovery.
Nucleus remains separately authoritative for Codex execution and authentication and is not stopped or replaced by an Annals deployment.
success: Installed Annals and Annals Usage versions and help surfaces match the selected release.
Library validation, spool status, LaunchAgent state, Nucleus readiness, and deliberate Annals and usage canaries pass as applicable.
Maintenance is cleared only after the complete cutover commits and backlog processing is intentionally resumed.
failure_and_recovery: Do not remove maintenance, edit spool receipts, or replace library files manually after interrupted deployment; inspect and use the documented recovery procedure.
A failed ordinary update restores the previous captured generation before work resumes.
A fresh-state cutover is destructive to the active generation and requires explicit retained rollback material and backlog verification.
privacy: Installed library, spool, backups, configuration, logs, and Nucleus output may contain complete private sources and model context.
Deployment must preserve private user ownership and permissions across both current and rollback generations.
does_not_authorize: Running `annals/release.sh`, which commits, tags, and pushes.
A fresh-state replacement without explicit destructive-operation authority.
Deleting prior generations, backups, logs, or retained failed envelopes.
